record.name: Vercel
record.one_liner: Vercel REST API enables programmatic interaction with your Vercel account, allowing deployment of web applications, management of domains, deployments, secrets, and environment variables.

auth.notes: Vercel Access Tokens are used to authenticate and use the Vercel API, included in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

access.notes: Users can create and manage Access Tokens in their account settings.

api_surface.notes: The API is exposed as an HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 service over SSL and follows the REST architecture.

mcp.notes: The Vercel MCP server allows agents to search docs, manage projects and deployments, and query Web Analytics.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
